definitions.explanation: A point that lies exactly or approximately in the middle between two ends, stages, or positions. Used both for physical locations and abstract progress through a process or project.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中間|ちゅうかん}{点|てん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通過|つうか}した→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧。
examples.english: I passed the halfway point of the marathon.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ようやく{中間|ちゅうかん}{点|てん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: The project has finally reached the midpoint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中間|ちゅうかん}{点|てん}あたり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名古屋|なごや}→名古屋：19405_nagoya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Nagoya is located roughly at the midpoint between Tokyo and Osaka.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧ (middle, intermediate) and ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point). Used for both physical locations along a route and figurative milestones in a process, project, or timeline.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中間|ちゅうかん}{点|てん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通過|つうか}する→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧: to pass the midpoint
- {中間|ちゅうかん}{点|てん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach the midpoint
- {中間|ちゅうかん}{点|てん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧: to be located at the midpoint
- {中間|ちゅうかん}{点|てん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to pass beyond the midpoint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}→折り返し地点：19047_orikaeshichiten⟧: turnaround point — specifically the point where one turns back on a course
- ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧⟦{地点|ちてん}→地点：04058_chiten⟧: midpoint location — emphasizes the physical place rather than an abstract point
- ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧: center — the geometric or spatial middle of an area, not a point along a path
